accounting.rationale: The statement confers PARAMETER and defines corresponding named-constant values. Attribute/identity meaning retains8.5.13; p4 supplies the statement-specific value/conversion effect. This is not execution of an assignment statement.
R854/R855 is a separate specification-statement route, not PARAMETER in a type-declaration attr-spec. C807's per-entity initializer condition applies to that different type-declaration form.
8.5.13/C852/C853 retain named-constant identity and role/constant-bound conditions. The statement neither assigns to a mutable variable nor implies a saved variable's initialization.

Every listed named constant has its corresponding definition under R855. R606 defines named-constant syntax; a declaration without earlier PARAMETER is not invalid merely because this statement supplies that attribute.
R401 supplies a nonempty comma-separated named-constant-def list. Unlike most neighboring attribute statements, the whole list is parenthesized and R854 has no optional double-colon group.
Explicit R606, not an arbitrary designator or a requirement for a prior PARAMETER spelling. Entity role, typing and array declaration remain separately constrained.

10.1.12/C1012 supplies the actual constant-expression conditions. Qualified property inquiries on variables are not value references; a PURE user procedure is not automatically a permitted constant expression. C7119's direct BOZ consumer conditions remain separate.
Two distinct ordering restrictions: subsequent type/parameter declarations versus the applicable implicit mapping, and a named array's rank specified before its PARAMETER statement.
Both sentences restrict named constants defined through the PARAMETER statement; this route is not inferred from a type-declaration initializer.

8.7 includes explicit IMPLICIT mappings, host defaults where applicable, and a null mapping under IMPLICIT NONE(TYPE). The statement does not override a prior legitimate explicit type or demand that every named constant match the default first-letter type.

A later dimension declaration is not a prior specification. Implied shape can obtain extents from the expression, but its declared rank must already be supplied. C864 does not generally admit RANK clauses on named constants.

10.2.1.2/Table10.8 owns numeric, logical, character, derived, enum/enumeration and type-parameter conformance. This is not permission for arbitrary user-defined assignment, generic bit copies or all BOZ receiver types.
An implied-shape named array requires equal expression rank. The other branch's scalar allowance does not allow a rank-zero initializer for a positive-rank implied-shape constant.

A nonscalar expression in the non-implied-shape branch must have the same shape, not merely the same rank or number of elements. Named constants do not receive allocatable assignment's shape-changing exception.

Only the required value conversion is imported. The PARAMETER statement is not an executable variable assignment; no allocation, deallocation, finalization, callback order or physical-storage effect is inferred.
Shape agreement uses the admitted p3 branch. Scalar expansion is not arbitrary reshaping or a way to bypass implied-shape rank equality.
The original two-definition example illustrates an intrinsic constant expression and an integer literal. It does not supply complete surrounding declarations or another mandatory program.
MOD(28,3) illustrates a standard intrinsic constant expression. A future completed integer witness can independently expect1, with ordinary representability and name-resolution premises retained.
The second definition illustrates a separate integer constant100, not a live-world fact or a language requirement tied to the descriptive identifier.

Both displayed names begin in the default I-N integer range if no conflicting mapping applies. A completion using IMPLICIT NONE needs explicit prior types; the fragment does not mandate one universal declaration order.

requirements.title: A PARAMETER statement encloses a nonempty definition list in parentheses
requirements.definition: PARAMETER is followed by a parenthesized nonempty named-constant-def list. Commas separate definitions under R401. This production does not contain an optional double colon, a listless form, or an executable assignment statement.

pending.single-definition-form: PENDING a complete ordinary program with prior INTEGER n and PARAMETER(n=2), without a PARAMETER attr-spec or other initialization. Compile admission requires no use of an uninitialized variable and does not itself prove the constant's runtime-observed value.
pending.multiple-definition-form: PENDING prior INTEGER n,m and PARAMETER(n=2,m=7) in a complete specification part. Distinct names and independent constant expressions avoid forward-reference and duplicate-attribute defects; R401 and R855 retain their owners.
pending.empty-list-exclusion: PENDING PARAMETER() with a prior-typed eligible name n, repaired only by inserting n=2. Require the actual nonempty-definition-list cause rather than unrelated EOF, role or unsupported-feature output.
pending.parenthesis-and-colon-repairs: PENDING separate complete contrasts missing one opening or closing parenthesis, each repaired only at that delimiter. A separate PARAMETER :: (n=2) contrast removes only the unadmitted double colon. Do not copy neighboring statements' optional-colon grammar or combine multiple malformed sites.
pending.type-declaration-route-source: PENDING finite R854/R855 versus R801/R802/R805/C807 relationships. INTEGER,PARAMETER requires its own initializer, while a prior INTEGER n followed by PARAMETER(n=2) is a different permitted route. Giving PARAMETER explicitly twice remains C815; no existing declaration case is cloned or automatically a statement witness.

requirements.oracle: Complete compile admissions and source-minimal grammar repairs with correct types, unique attributes and valid constant expressions. Statement envelopes do not supply value/conversion, prior-rank or namespace evidence by themselves.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Reporting capability does not mandate fatal rejection, fixed English or a printed R854. Missing types, duplicate attributes, a nonconstant expression, inappropriate entity role, parser recovery or unsupported facilities are not the intended delimiter/list cause.

requirements.title: Each PARAMETER definition has a named constant, equals sign and constant expression
requirements.definition: A named-constant-def consists of a named-constant, an equals sign and a constant-expr. R606 defines the name form and10.1.12 defines constant-expression eligibility. The statement supplies PARAMETER; a previous PARAMETER attribute is not required. Type, shape, prior definition and special BOZ consumer restrictions remain independent.

pending.literal-definition: PENDING complete prior INTEGER n and one definition n=7 inside R854's parentheses. A real constant definition, not an executable assignment to n or a second PARAMETER attr-spec, is required.
pending.named-expression-definition: PENDING a previously defined INTEGER named constant basis=3 and a later definition n=basis+4; a separately qualified same-statement earlier definition retains8.5.13p2 ownership. Any actual value observer expects independent literal7, not the same expression as its only oracle.
pending.missing-name-or-value: PENDING separate (=2) and (n=) definition contrasts in complete, otherwise valid PARAMETER statements, repaired only by inserting the prior-typed name or literal value. The other half and list envelope stay valid; reject unrelated name/type recovery as evidence.
pending.equals-not-pointer-arrow: PENDING prior ordinary INTEGER n and PARAMETER(n=>2), repaired only by deleting the greater-than character. Do not declare n POINTER merely to manufacture this syntax negative; that would introduce separate PARAMETER/POINTER role conflicts. The causal expression/definition report must be source-qualified.
pending.name-not-element-designator: PENDING prior INTEGER a(2) with PARAMETER(a(1)=2), repaired only to PARAMETER(a=2). The whole-array scalar-initializer control is admitted by p3 and has prior rank; an element is not R606's bare name. Do not use an incompatible derived-scalar repair or add a second rank specification.
pending.constant-expression-and-BOZ-owner-relati: PENDING exact R1030/C1012 and10.1.12 relationships for prior constants, constructors and eligible property inquiries such as SIZE of a previously declared fixed-shape object. Its undefined payload is not read. PURE user procedures and variable value references are not automatically constant. C7119 separately admits direct BOZ initialization for INTEGER/REAL named constants; it does not make BOZ a typed arithmetic operand or grant arbitrary receiver/parenthesization contexts. Existing BOZ programs and the real-representation gate remain unchanged.

requirements.oracle: Qualified name/equal/expression syntax controls and minimal malformed-definition repairs; semantic constant-expression, typing, rank and BOZ predicates retain their canonical source and evidence owners.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No general expression, pointer arrow, component reference, function call or literal is interchangeable with a named constant definition. Numbered reports need actual causes/origins and valid controls; generic constancy/role words, echoes, unsupported features or compiler failures do not qualify.

requirements.title: Subsequent type declarations for a PARAMETER-defined constant preserve its implicit type mapping
requirements.definition: After a named constant is defined by a PARAMETER statement, a subsequent declaration must not give it a type or type parameter value different from what its applicable implicit mapping would supply. This is a restriction on a subsequent declaration, not a demand that every previously explicitly typed constant match a default first-letter type.

pending.late-matching-integer-control: PENDING a complete program intentionally using the default implicit INTEGER mapping for n: PARAMETER(n=2) followed by INTEGER n. There is no earlier explicit type declaration to duplicate, and no IMPLICIT NONE(TYPE). Source review must retain the actual statement ordering before any compile control.
pending.late-different-type-source-gate: PENDING the otherwise identical PARAMETER(n=2) followed by REAL n, repaired only to INTEGER n. The INTEGER literal is type-compatible with either numeric type for initialization; the intended violation is p2's subsequent-type comparison. Establish a legitimate reporting/scope basis or explicit processor policy before negative metadata; this prose alone does not require a trap or universal fatal rejection.
pending.late-character-length-source-gate: PENDING a complete custom IMPLICIT CHARACTER(LEN=2) mapping for the initial letter c, PARAMETER(c='AB'), then a later CHARACTER(LEN=3) c declaration. Repair only the later length to2. Check original IMPLICIT grammar and all other declaration conditions independently; do not use IMPLICIT NONE or an initial implicit REAL character mismatch as a false control.
pending.prior-explicit-type-boundary: PENDING prior explicit LOGICAL n followed by PARAMETER(n=.TRUE.) and no later type declaration. The explicit prior type overrides default implicit INTEGER despite the name's first letter. This compile control distinguishes p2's temporal condition from a blanket implicit-type-only rule; any value effect keeps its own owner.
pending.implicit-mapping-and-kind-boundaries: PENDING8.7p1/p3/p4 and host/interface mapping relations, null IMPLICIT NONE(TYPE) mappings and separately qualified supported-kind changes. An undeclared-name error is not this subsequent-declaration predicate. Do not guess numeric kind identifiers, require a second INTEGER kind universally, or introduce unsupported declarations behind runtime guards.

requirements.oracle: Complete matching-order/type controls and a finite source/reporting gate for later type or parameter changes, with explicit applicable implicit mappings and minimal repairs.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The condition must not be generalized to declarations preceding PARAMETER. No new mandatory prose diagnosis, compiler-consensus type rule, duplicated explicit type, unsupported kind or invalid IMPLICIT setup is a valid oracle.

requirements.title: A named array constant has its rank specified before its PARAMETER statement
requirements.definition: An array named constant defined using PARAMETER has its rank specified in a prior specification statement. Inferring rank from a value expression or declaring it afterward does not satisfy this ordering. Implied extents and declared rank are different properties.

pending.prior-type-array-spec: PENDING complete INTEGER a(2) followed by PARAMETER(a=[3,7]), with constant bounds, matching type and shape, no additional rank declaration and no prior PARAMETER attribute.
pending.prior-dimension-statement: PENDING prior INTEGER a then DIMENSION a(2), followed by PARAMETER(a=5). The scalar expression avoids an unrelated array-expression shape defect. R851 and source ordering remain canonical, and no RANK clause is substituted.
pending.later-rank-source-gate: PENDING the same well-typed scalar-initializer context with DIMENSION a(2) after PARAMETER(a=5), repaired by moving only the dimension specification before the definition. Adjudicate declaration/category interpretation and any overlapping diagnostics before an optional policy or source-use receipt. Do not add an array RHS that independently fails the then-scalar context.
pending.implied-shape-and-RANK-clause-boundaries: PENDING a prior INTEGER a(*) declaration and later PARAMETER(a=[3,7]), with final named-constant identity, declared rank1 and extents supplied by the constant expression under8.5.8.6. The ambiguous star spelling is not automatically an ordinary assumed-size local. RANK clauses have C864 dummy/ALLOCATABLE/POINTER premises that do not generally admit a named constant; no invalid RANK(0) repair is proposed.

requirements.oracle: Complete prior-rank admissions and independently qualified source-order contrasts, using the actual prior declaration and final named-constant role.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Prior rank is not initialized data, lower-bound equality, allocation or a later inquiry result. The prose does not automatically require a fatal compiler report, and canonical DIMENSION, implied-shape and C853 rules remain operative.

requirements.title: Each PARAMETER expression has compatible type parameters and the required rank or shape
requirements.definition: Each corresponding constant expression conforms in type and type parameters under intrinsic-assignment rules. An implied-shape named constant requires the same expression rank. Otherwise the expression is scalar or has the same shape as the named constant. Scalar expansion is not permission to initialize an implied-shape array from a scalar or reshape arbitrary arrays.

pending.intrinsic-type-conformance-source: PENDING exact10.2.1.2/Table10.8 source relationships for allowed numeric combinations and logical/character restrictions, in actual PARAMETER definitions with prior types. Compile controls do not require exact REAL/COMPLEX value oracles, but runtime conversion claims do. A defined-assignment generic cannot legalize an intrinsically incompatible constant initialization.
pending.derived-enum-parameter-conformance-sourc: PENDING same-derived-type, kind/length-parameter and enum/enumeration table conditions with complete legitimate constant constructors. Preserve enum versus enumeration distinctions and the enumerator-primary requirement on applicable INTEGER enum expressions. No private/inaccessible or otherwise invalid constructor, allocation exception or general INTEGER-to-enumeration conversion is a control.
pending.implied-shape-equal-rank: PENDING prior INTEGER a(*) with PARAMETER(a=[3,7]), and a separately qualified rank-two implied-shape constant with a constant rank-two expression. Its extents are inferred, but its rank already exists. Use actual whole named objects if properties are observed, not RANK of a constructor expression.
pending.implied-shape-scalar-exclusion-source: PENDING prior rank-one implied-shape a(*) with scalar PARAMETER(a=3), repaired only by making the expression [3]. This preserves a named constant and makes expression rank1. Qualify the rank predicate and actual diagnostic policy; do not claim the explicit-shape scalar-broadcast exception applies here.
pending.explicit-shape-scalar-admission: PENDING prior INTEGER a(2,2) with PARAMETER(a=5). The scalar expression is permitted in this non-implied-shape branch. Actual element values, if tested, belong to S8.6.11-004's finite value effect rather than a second no-op admission.
pending.explicit-shape-array-conformance: PENDING a prior fixed-shape INTEGER a(2) and matching [3,7] expression; a mismatched extent or rank variant needs its exact p3/canonical basis and a minimal conforming repair before diagnostic-policy credit. Equal element count alone is not equal shape. Named constants do not acquire allocatable reallocation semantics.
pending.zero-extent-and-character-boundaries: PENDING explicit zero-extent array conformance source/control relationships, retaining every dimension rather than only total size. Empty data definedness is not evidence of correct initialization or hidden bounds. Default CHARACTER length may differ and be converted under10.2.1.3p11; supported character-kind and derived length-parameter conditions remain distinct. No broad same-length rule or unsupported-kind control.

requirements.oracle: Complete parameter-definition compatibility controls plus source-qualified contrasts, retaining canonical type tables and both conditional rank/shape branches. Prose alone does not create universal diagnostic obligations.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No array-count broadcasting, automatic allocation, runtime trap, invalid constructor or unqualified numeric representation oracle. Generic assignment/construction cases are not automatically PARAMETER-statement occurrences or new evidence links.

requirements.title: PARAMETER definitions supply the corresponding constant values with prescribed conversion
requirements.source: 8.6.11 p1 value specification and p4, physical PDF139
requirements.definition: Each named constant has the value specified by its corresponding constant expression, converted where necessary by intrinsic-assignment value rules to agree in type, type parameters and shape. The statement-specific initial-value observation does not execute an assignment to a variable, waive p3 compatibility, or import allocation/finalization/callback behavior.

pending.simple-derived-values: PENDING a complete visible derived type with two ordinary INTEGER components and no default initialization, pointers, allocatables or defined-assignment generic. Define a named constant through PARAMETER with a constant structure constructor and observe independent component literals3/7. Component value and constructor rules retain their canonical owners; no automatic link, duplicate runtime assignment or callback-count claim.
pending.numeric-kind-and-BOZ-oracle-gates: PENDING processor-qualified additional INTEGER/LOGICAL kind conversions and independently justified REAL/COMPLEX approximation oracles. Do not assume kind numbers, a universally available second kind or exact finite REAL conversion by consensus. Direct INTEGER/REAL BOZ initialization retains C7119, destination-kind/capacity and ordered-bit conversion conditions; INTEGER high-bit interpretation and the real representation/ordering bridge remain separate gates. Neither TRANSFER folklore nor the operation under test supplies profile eligibility, and the existing real-BOZ NEEDS_ORACLE case/profile is unchanged.

requirements.oracle:
Actual named constants initialized by PARAMETER, observed through independent finite values and complete execution/check guards, with whole-program wrong-oracle sensitivity. Conditional numeric/representation work stays explicitly pending until independently qualified.

S8.6.11-004 finite statement-value effects: six complete run/effect/f2023 programs define actual named constants using PARAMETER statements after explicit type and rank declarations. An internal observer directly checks the host-associated constants, not copied variable stand-ins. The INTEGER program checks separate first=3 and second=7 values and MOD(28,3) against the independent literal1. The LOGICAL program checks true and false using logical equivalence without a representation or I/O-spelling assumption. Default CHARACTER programs check length4 and AB followed by two blanks, and length2 with right truncation to AB; whole values and individual positions have independent character literals. The truncation program also observes an actual assumed-length named constant defined as CDE, with independent length3 and value CDE. A fixed vector is checked elementwise against3/7; a fixed2x2 array with scalar initializer5 has all four actual elements checked against5. Main requires one observer entry, one normal return, all individual value/property checks and three completed caller checks before exact completion stdout, empty stderr and exit0. Every assertion and completion literal has a one-span complete-parent wrong-oracle mutation. Separate full-program omissions remove the call, the observer body or one observation with its check increment; entry/count guards detect them. Only a current passing complete parent and the intended runtime failure establish sensitivity.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
The original source-only registration supplied no cases. Constant-expression eligibility, p2 ordering and p3 compatibility are prerequisites; a declaration-only empty run or a re-evaluated initializer is not an independent value effect. Named constants are not mutable saved variables, and intrinsic-assignment conversion references promise no allocator, finalization, user callback, address or ABI mechanism.

S8.6.11-004 finite statement-value boundaries: only the six named finite default-kind value facets are represented. The simple-derived and numeric-kind-and-BOZ plans remain pending, as do every foreign requirement and unselected source/interface/grammar facet. No implicit-typing, late-rank, implied-shape, zero-sized-array, optional-kind, REAL/COMPLEX, BOZ, storage-layout, ABI, pointer, allocation, finalization or defined-assignment effect is inferred. The MOD observation uses literal1, not a second MOD evaluation. Padding compares both trailing positions and the declared length, without relying only on unequal-length character comparison. Named constants are never assigned or passed to a defining dummy, and the PARAMETER conversion reference is not a runtime assignment operation. Canonical constant-expression, MOD, LEN, character, constructor and intrinsic-assignment rules retain their owners; no reuse link or duplicate runtime execution is invented. Guard markers are program output, not mandated ERROR STOP English or a universal numeric error status. Build failures, missing artifacts/traces, failed or stale parents, preempting guards, crashes and resource/time failures cannot qualify sensitivity. Actual f2018 observations are supplementary to f2023 qualification. Generation grants no review and changes no baseline, index or evidence inventory.
